scope: Seven named runtime/client sources and pinned public recovery dependency; static source, AST and public source hashes only.

checked_contracts.shared_budget: Exclusive fsynced flat ledger; unsafe/unresolved records retain full or greater protection; any UNKNOWN blocks new case/post claims; no retry or reclaim.
checked_contracts.old_closed12: Provenance only; no old requests or unknown protection reclaimed into this cohort.
checked_contracts.permanent_stop: Exclusive protocol-bound first marker; future case/post claims deny its presence. Transport stop/context errors and raised/stopped targets call stop_cohort. Root critical-quality stop requires review SHA.
checked_contracts.normal_valid_checker_negative: Counted and preserved; no automatic semantic STOP, as explicitly directed by Root. Client is not quality decision owner.
checked_contracts.Root_sequence_required: Finish case, close owned worker, recover read-only, independently review necessary facts/citations, then explicit GO before next case. Critical falsepositive writes review SHA and permanent stop.
checked_contracts.preparation: Prewarm before listener and Send; query_encoded=False; freeze-only preparer no longer regenerates stale controller templates.
checked_contracts.deadline: 180 seconds anchored at transport case claim after prewarm; bounded normal provider timeout and 200000-byte compiled wire cap.
checked_contracts.worker: One freshly accepted exact job with owned lock/token and frozen command; no queue scan, old-job takeover, retry or regeneration.
checked_contracts.client: Loopback18029; one question POST; 210-second work poll deadline, 15-second idle closure; API-only n=0 and no browser/quality claim.
checked_contracts.public_scope: Disabled profile/history; exact current public corpus release/chunk/span checks; auth remains memory-only and never enters wire/export.
checked_contracts.recovery: Closed exact job/request/session binding; read-only bounded queries; original teacher text and checker inputs/judgment preserved; double privacy checks and no provider calls.

resolved_pre_final_findings.finding: Permanent STOP was only checked, never created.
resolved_pre_final_findings.resolution: Existing-budget stop_cohort and transport/server calls added; Root owns the pinned independent quality stop.

resolved_pre_final_findings.finding: Initial preparer could regenerate stale ledger-path/snapshot templates.
resolved_pre_final_findings.resolution: One-time generator archived; current preparer only freezes reviewed sources/public inputs.
